Campaign Brief

⚡️ Data Quality

🗓️ Campaign Details

Start Date:Now
End Date:Flexible
Segment:Techies (IT, Analysts, CTO, etc)

🎯 Messaging

Problem

Freight brokers make critical decisions — carrier selection, pricing, lane optimization — using TMS data that hasn't been checked for quality. This leads to mistrust and often results in decisions using incomplete or erroneous data.

Main Points

  • Axiom-Apps catches data errors before they reach your reports. Built-in, AI-powered safeguards flag common data entry mistakes automatically — so bad numbers don't make it into your analysis in the first place.
  • We stop you from mixing data that shouldn't be combined. Our system flags when you're about to analyze TL and LTL together, or blend delivered and non-delivered shipments — the kind of mixing that quietly skews results.
  • Your TMS wasn't built for analytics — Axiom-Apps was. Transactional systems weren't designed to catch data quality issues. We close that gap, so the reporting layer actually does the job your TMS can't.
  • Trustworthy data means confident decisions. When you know the numbers are clean, you can act on them — for carrier selection, pricing, or lane strategy — without second-guessing.

Campaign Brief

⚡️ Carrier Scorecard

🗓️ Campaign Details

Start Date:Now
End Date:Flexible
Segment:Freight brokerage ops leaders, carrier managers, pricing analysts

🎯 Messaging

Problem

1) Most 3PLs and freight brokers don't evaluate their carriers by lane — even though that's where performance and profitability truly diverge. 2) They're relying on high-level market averages (like DAT) instead of using their own shipment data to make targeted, strategic decisions. 3) Carrier costs are the single biggest expenditure for most logistics providers, yet they're not able to effectively score their carriers to ensure they're making great carrier selection choices.

Main Points

  • Score carriers by lane, not just in aggregate. Axiom-Apps lets you analyze performance by lane — so you can see which carriers are truly delivering on-time, on-budget.
  • Use your own data to find the best carriers. The answers aren't in DAT or a market average. Your own shipment history reveals who your top performers are and where you're bleeding margin.
  • Filter by the metrics that matter to you. Use on-time %, margin, carrier spend, and more. You choose the metrics, then filter by lane, customer, or carrier to find the patterns.
  • Catch underperformance fast. Spot carriers with late loads, missed pickups, or declining performance before it becomes a fire drill.
  • Make rebid and routing decisions with confidence. Your scorecards don't just highlight top performers — they help you know when it's time to negotiate, reassign, or remove a carrier.
  • Get automated carrier reports sent straight to you. Customize the reports you need, when you need them — no clutter, no manual work.

🖥️ Screen Shots

🎬 Content/CTAs

  • See 5 ways our scorecards improve carrier selection
  • Here's how to optimize your carrier mix
  • Want me to send you a quick demo?

Campaign Brief

⚡️ Automated Reporting

🗓️ Campaign Details

Start Date:Now
End Date:Flexible
Segment:Freight Ops, Analytics Managers, VPs of Operation, Account Managers

🎯 Messaging

Problem

Freight brokers waste hours every week formatting raw TMS data, doing manual analysis in Excel, and building reports by hand — all to get basic shipment insights. The process is slow, error-prone, and manual. And it delays the insights that drive smarter pricing, better carrier selection decisions, and stronger customer relationships.

Main Points

  • Save hours every week. Automated shipment reporting eliminates manual work. Just upload your spreadsheet — the system takes care of the rest.
  • Set it once, and you're done. Reports automatically update with your latest shipment data, on your schedule. No rework. No reformatting.
  • Only the metrics you need. From carrier performance to late loads or margin by customer, we tailor your reports to highlight the KPIs that matter — without the clutter.
  • Designed for freight. Unlike generic BI tools, our system understands TMS data and speaks transportation out of the box.
  • Catch issues before they snowball. Late shipments, margin drops, and volume slowdowns stand out immediately — so you don't have to wait for the next QBR to act.
  • Automate reports internally or to your customers.

Common Report Types

  • Carrier Costs Breakdown
  • Sales Team Performance
  • Late Shipment Predictions
  • Item-Level Margins
  • Customer Volume Trends
  • Profit & Costs by Lane
  • Missing Lanes & Missing Customers
  • Revenue Predictions
  • Profitability Updates

Campaign Brief

⚡️ Adopters Program

🗓️ Campaign Details

Start Date:Now
Hard Stop:April 30
Segment:Mid-size freight brokers

🎯 Messaging

Problem

Small-to-mid-size 3PLs and freight brokers know that data can unlock better decisions — but most don't have the time, tools, or expertise to put analytics into action. Despite access to TMS data, many struggle to turn that information into meaningful insights that drive margin improvement, operational efficiency, or customer value. Without a clear path forward, analytics remains an untapped advantage — leaving brokers to rely on guesswork, gut instinct, or time-consuming manual reporting.

Main Points

  • Learn to leverage your TMS data for profit. Your TMS holds the answers — you just need to know where to look. We help you uncover margin opportunities, spot inefficiencies, and make smarter decisions using the data you already have.
  • 30 days of hands-on help. The Analytics Adopters Program includes expert support to make sure you're not just logging in — but actually getting value. Our analytics experts guide you through high-impact use cases tailored to managed transportation and freight brokerage.
  • How-Tos delivered to your inbox. Get practical guidance, proven playbooks, and step-by-step walkthroughs — so you can start using analytics confidently without the guesswork.
  • Analytics that drive action. Most brokers don't need more data — they need the right insights at the right time. Axiom-Apps is purpose-built for freight, so brokers can immediately see what's working, what's not, and what to do next.
  • Designed for busy teams — give us one hour per week! No analysts? No problem. Axiom-Apps delivers insight without needing to build dashboards, hire data scientists, or wait for IT.
  • Built for freight brokers. Every chart, view, and metric is rooted in the realities of running a logistics business — so insights are always relevant, actionable, and ready to drive results.
  • Zero cost, zero risk. The Analytics Adopters Program gives you 30 days of full access to Axiom-Apps, free of charge. You get to try before you buy — and we help you succeed along the way.
